name: Shipper360
author: Shipper

sections.description:
Shipper connects WooCommerce with major Greek carriers, offering real-time rates, label generation, and shipment tracking.
A Shipper account is required to use this plugin.

External Service Usage (Required by WP.org Guideline 6)

This plugin communicates with the external logistics platform Shipper (shipper360.io) to retrieve carrier rates, generate shipping labels, and process shipment tracking updates.

Shipper provides services including:
* Multi-carrier shipping rates (ACS, Speedex, Geniki)
* Shipment creation with label generation
* Delivery point lookup
* Shipment tracking and status updates
* Webhook notifications for order status changes

External service links:
* Terms of Use: https://www.shipper360.io/en/terms-of-use/
* Privacy Policy: https://www.shipper360.io/en/privacy-policy-gdpr/
* Data Processing Agreement (DPA): https://www.shipper360.io/en/dpa-data-processing-agreement/
* Website: https://www.shipper360.io

External Service: OpenStreetMap (Map & Geocoding)

To let customers choose a delivery locker or store on a map at checkout, this plugin uses OpenStreetMap services. This only happens on the checkout page, and only when a pickup-point shipping method is available.

  • Map tiles are loaded from OpenStreetMap tile servers to render the interactive pickup-point map.
  • Nominatim (nominatim.openstreetmap.org) geocodes the customer’s postcode into map coordinates so the nearest pickup point can be suggested. Only the postcode and the country (Greece) are sent — no personal or order data. Results are cached for 7 days to minimise requests.

OpenStreetMap links:
* Terms of Use: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Terms_of_Use
* Privacy Policy: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy
* Nominatim Usage Policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/

What Data is Sent to Shipper

The plugin sends only the data required to provide shipping functionality:

During rate calculation (checkout/cart):
* Destination country, city, postcode
* Package weight and dimensions
* Cart/order total value
* Selected carrier/service
* Store API credentials

During shipment creation (manual or automated):
* Customer shipping name
* Shipping address (street, city, postal code, country)
* Customer phone and email
* Order number and WooCommerce order metadata
* Package contents (items, weight, dimensions)
* Selected carrier service and delivery point (if any)

During webhook communication (from Shipper to your site):
* Shipment status updates (accepted, in transit, delivered, failed, returned)
* Tracking number
* Carrier event timestamps

No payment or billing information is ever sent to Shipper.

Key Features

  • Multi-carrier support (ACS, Speedex, Geniki)
  • Real-time shipping rate calculation
  • Automated shipping label generation
  • Live shipment tracking
  • Customer tracking notifications
  • Delivery point selection
  • Return shipment handling
  • Bulk label printing
  • Custom shipping rules

Carrier Integration

  • ACS Courier: Real-time rates, label generation, and tracking
  • Speedex: Automated shipping with service area support
  • Geniki: Complete shipping integration with delivery points

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Valid Shipper API credentials

Support

For support please contact:
* info@shipper360.io

Privacy Policy

This plugin processes:
* Order shipping details
* Customer delivery data
* Store location information

This data is transmitted securely to the external Shipper service for:
* Shipping rate calculation
* Label generation
* Tracking updates

For full Shipper privacy details, please review:
* https://www.shipper360.io/en/privacy-policy-gdpr/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ‘shipper’ folder to the ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Shipping → Shipper
  4. Enter your API credentials
  5. Configure your shipping preferences
sections.faq:
Do I need a Shipper account?

Yes, you need a valid Shipper account to use this plugin. Visit shipper360.io to create an account.

Which carriers are supported?

ACS, Speedex, and Geniki.

How are shipping rates calculated?

Rates are calculated in real time based on:
* Package dimensions and weight
* Delivery destination
* Selected carrier
* Your negotiated or standard rates

Can I track shipments?

Yes, tracking is available through:
* WooCommerce order page
* Customer order emails
* Tracking page widget
sections.changelog:
1.1

  • New: Pickup point / locker selection at checkout with an interactive map (lockers and stores), including nearest-point suggestion based on the delivery postcode.
  • New: Dedicated admin settings page (WooCommerce → Shipper360) with General, Orders, Tracking and Cache management tabs.
  • New: Subscription plan awareness — plan and remaining vouchers are shown, and the tracking feature is gated to Advanced/Enterprise plans with an upgrade notice on Starter.
  • New: Configurable WooCommerce order status → Shipper status mapping sent with webhooks.
  • New: Sandbox/demo mode toggle to switch between the production and demo Shipper API.
  • New: Wolt Drive carrier support.
  • Improvement: Cash on delivery is now disabled only for pickup points that cannot collect COD (e.g. ACS smartpoints/stores) while home delivery and BoxNow lockers keep COD.
  • Improvement: Webhook payload now includes the selected locker code and pickup point details, and backfills a missing phone number from custom checkout meta (filterable via shipper360_meta_field_fallbacks).
  • Improvement: Duplicate order.updated webhook fired while an order is being created is now suppressed.
  • Improvement: Admin styles/scripts now load only on the plugin’s own settings screen.
  • Improvement: Pickup points and postcode geocoding results are cached (transients) to reduce API calls.
  • Security: Tracking API requests now verify SSL certificates.
  • Compatibility: Tested up to WordPress 7.0.

1.0

  • Initial release
  • Multi-carrier support
  • Real-time rate calculation
  • Automated label generation
  • Shipment tracking
  • Customer notifications
  • Return handling
